name: autopilot
description: The CEO-agent for development work — hand it a rough idea and it maps the options, makes the tradeoffs, builds and reviews, and only pages you at red lines. Autopilot methodology skills for Codex with bundled support CLI/scripts. The manifest exposes skills only and does not load Claude Code hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Lifecycle and review-loop skills for Codex
interface.longDescription: The CEO-agent for development work — hand it a rough idea and it maps the options, makes the tradeoffs, builds and reviews, and only pages you at red lines. Autopilot brings its portable lifecycle, planning, verification, review, and cross-harness maintenance skills into Codex. The manifest declares only skills while the package payload bundles support CLI, scripts, references, templates, and shared helpers needed by those skills; it does not load Claude Code hook manifests.
defaultPrompt: Use Autopilot dev-flow for this change.
